## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `ci:`, `build:`, `perf:`)
- [ ] `./gradlew spotlessApply` run locally; `./gradlew check` is green
- [ ] New code has tests (or this PR explicitly explains why not)
- [ ] No `System.out` / `System.err` / `printStackTrace()` introduced
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or credentials added to source / fixtures
- [ ] Docs updated for any user-visible behavior change
